title: Tera 18/8 Stainless Steel Mortar and Pestle with Brush,Pill Crusher,Spice Grinder,Herb Bowl,Pesto Powder
description:
About this item
SOLID RUSTPROOF MATERIAL: Both pestle and mortar are made of food grade 18/8 stainless steel. Not only are they rustproof, it is also resistant to damage and corrosion by acidic food. Small compact mortar, about the size of the average palm - whereas one could pick it up with one hand, capacity 250ml
DURABLE AND STABLE: Made of solid metal, the pestle feels substantial in your hand and the mortar sits securely on your kitchen counter. Padding on the bottom makes it stay put even more.
FOOD-SAFE: Because stainless steel does not hold residue or leftover odor, all it takes is a thorough rinsing under the tap to get it ready for next use.
MESSY NOT: Translucent lid allows you to gauge your strikes and keeps the contents in the bowl, not over counter top.
ALL YOUR GRINDING NEEDS: This grinding setup will accommodate just about anyone’s grinding needs. From medical pills, to herbs and spices; from the pharmacy to your kitchen.
reviews_5s:
After breaking the marble pestle several times, this mortar and pestle are great. Plus I love the cover to keep the bird seed inside and it's not going all over the kitchen. I have two parrots and I grind up some of their seed and pellets so they'll eat them. I did keep the marble mortar and I can still use that with this stainless steel pestle. No more breakage.This mortar is good and heavy and can hold a good amount. It is easy to clean. I like it much better than the porcelain ones.Beautiful, well crafted with a nice weight to it. Great value and a stylish addition to my kitchen.This is a great product! The pestle is very comfortable, allowing me to apply steady pressure. The mortar has a sturdy base and the brushed finish keeps things from slipping away. The handy brush gets all the bits out. I have used it to crush pills and it works great! I have some dried herbs I will try next. Great price and nice looking, too.This works exactly as expected. Great quality.This thing is awesome! It could almost crush rocks if you tried hard enough. Not very big though.Works will for crushing pills. Will worth the moneyI used natural medicines which come in the form of very hard and tiny pills. The pill crusher I am throwing away made it impossible to pulverize the pills. Then I thought about a mortar and pestle and turned to Amazon. There are many mortar and pestles from which to choose, but the one that caught my attention is the stainless steel combo with two lids and a brush. The lid is fantastic because it keeps the pills inside the mortar as I smash them into a powder. I LOVE IT!
August 8, 2024 - I just read some of the four-star reviews and had to add to my "opinion." I have two lids. How that happened I consider a blessing. As to the lids not being clear, I have no problem removing the lid to check the progress of smashing those pills. Easy peasy. That brush is awesome. And the weight is great as well. Solid, sturdy. It took me by surprise but I adapted to it. I am no longer frustrated and dealing with a hand that kept getting bruised trying to use the pill crusher that went into the trash. Happy day!Working greatPretty impressed with this mortar & pestle combination. I remembered my Mother having a marble set of these when I was a kid -- sometimes she'd use it with herbs and seasonings for cooking. I didn't really have an immediate need for one when I purchased this set, just some vague ideas that I could use it for.

Now that I've had it for some time, there's some features that I think make this really nice: for one, it being metal really helps with cleanup -- depending on what you're using it for, it'll most definitely need a scrub afterward. The metal makes this easy, and also gives it a really nice weight (both items). The weight makes the process of using it feel really sturdy.

One thing I really didn't pay too much attention to originally (because my mother's never had one), but now really, really appreciate about this, is that it comes with the set of plastic covers to reduce spillage over the sides. This has been a lifesaver -- without it, you'd have to be really careful with your grinding, but instead you can just pop one of these covers and go to work without that issue at all.

The only downside that I can really think of is that it's a little on the smaller side -- great for most uses, but sometimes feel a larger mortar & pestle would have been a little easier to use. Oh well, this works perfectly for my needs, and I don't have to go out of my way to find a spot to keep it when in storage.

All-in-all, completely content with this purchase, very convenient item to have in the kitchen!
reviews_1s: Trusted this to be good quality due to the high rating. And I rarely have to return things that I order. Washed it thoroughly and then tried to grind some course sea salt. It turned the sea salt dark gray and it gave off a metallic odor. Washed it again and repeated the process, but it had the same results. The salt also left visible spotting in the surface of the mortar as well as the pestle. If it is real stainless (which I highly doubt), it’s far from food grade quality. I would not want it in contact with my food.The only reason I purchased this particular product was because the image included a mini sweet brush when the product arrived that was not inside the box.Very difficult to pound garlic b/c it's so shallow. Waste of money, sadly.I bought this stainless steel mortar/pestle to hand crush rock. After one day of use the pestle opened and revealed it's sand fill. The mortar is filled with concrete to give weight and got a crack on the middle after switching to a hammer due to the pestle failure. This product is not sturdy enough to be used for minerals, stick to plants with this.I'm sorry to say that when I went to hand wash it now, there are little rust stains. I wish I had examined it first in daylight. I just assumed it would be fine because my 18/8 utensils never get rusty, so I'm now skeptical that this product is 18/8 stainless steel. I am returning it immediately. This is so disappointing because, it has a cover and impossible to break. I wanted to love it.Cheap crap. Metal started to chip off from trying to grind some things.
